citation: Barker, M. K., et al. (2023), A New View of the Lunar South Pole from the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter, The Planetary Science Journal, https://doi.org/10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1. LOLA DEM LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ, NASA GSFC PGDA product 90, https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/90.
coordinateReference: MOON_ME / DE421 sphere, radius 1737400 m, south-polar stereographic metres. +X toward east longitude 90°, +Y toward east longitude 0°. Row 0 is the maximum-Y side. originX and originY are the centre of pixel (0,0).
preparationNote: Windowed read with rasterio and GDAL /vsicurl/ from the cloud-optimized GeoTIFF. Analysis heights are the native 80 m postings, rounded to 0.01 m, with no spatial resampling. The display hillshade is a separate 2x2 block mean and is not this grid. Horizon search radius is 12000 m; the window keeps that radius inside the grid for every example site.
nodataPolicy: Source nodata is NaN. This window has no nodata. Missing mask azimuths are never filled as flat.
